PORT.description: serve: the port the HTTP server listens on.

OSF_DATA.description: serve: the folder of the runs' working folders, runs/<run ID>, and of the harness adapters' session records.

OSF_NOW.description: The current time, like 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, for the times of runs and stages. Default: the clock.

FOREMAN_API_TOKEN.description: serve: the token that callers of /v1 send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Required.

FOREMAN_FACTORY.description: serve: the factory definition. Its folder must be in a Git repository: a run's factory version is its commit.

FOREMAN_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS.description: serve: the gRPC address of the Temporal server.

FOREMAN_TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE.description: serve: the Temporal namespace of the runs.

FOREMAN_TASK_QUEUE.description: serve: the Temporal task queue of the runs' workflows and activities.

FOREMAN_HARNESSES.description: serve: a JSON object from harness name to the command line of its adapter. A harness it does not name runs npx -y @opensoftware/harness-<name> run.

FOREMAN_POLL_MS.description: serve: how often a running stage looks for steering messages and a cancel, in milliseconds.

FOREMAN_GATEKEEPER_URL.description: serve: the URL of gatekeeper serve, which a stage with a gate asks for a decision. Required for a factory with gates.

FOREMAN_NATS_URL.description: serve: the NATS server for work.received@v1 and gate.decided@v1 in, and run.started@v1 and run.completed@v1 out. Unset: no events.
